name: Katy Asian Town
summary: Katy Asian Town is Houston's iconic destination for authentic Asian culture, featuring over 150 stores, diverse dining from dim sum to KBBQ, and entertainment including an IMAX cinema and family attractions. This curated lifestyle hub brings together the best of Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Vietnamese flavors, fashion, and experiences in one vibrant marketplace.
demographics: Katy Asian Town primarily attracts Asian-American families and food enthusiasts from the greater Houston metropolitan area, with a strong concentration of Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Vietnamese communities. The trade area draws middle to upper-middle income households seeking authentic Asian cuisine, specialty groceries, and cultural experiences. Visitors typically range from young professionals to multi-generational families, with high engagement during weekends and cultural festivals. The center serves as a cultural hub for Houston's diverse Asian population while also attracting food tourists and mainstream shoppers interested in authentic Asian dining and entertainment experiences.
description: Katy Asian Town & Marketplace stands as Houston's premier destination for authentic Asian culture, cuisine, and lifestyle experiences. Located at 23119 Colonial Parkway in Katy, Texas, this vibrant lifestyle center brings together the best of Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Vietnamese traditions under one roof. The center features over 150 stores offering everything from high-street fashion to premium luxury brands, alongside an impressive culinary scene with authentic dim sum, sushi, Korean BBQ, hot pot, poke, noodles, and boba tea. Entertainment options include a state-of-the-art cinema with IMAX and 4DX screens, the Andretti Family Thrill Zone for family fun, and regular cultural events like the annual Lunar Fest. With over 1 million annual visitors, ample parking spaces, and convenient hours seven days a week, Katy Asian Town has established itself as a landmark plaza where fashion, food, and fun converge to create an immersive Asian cultural experience in the heart of suburban Houston.
